subject.title: Enhancement: Developer experience quick wins from code analysis

question: Should CLI plugin diagnostics and non-tool skill prompt-rewrite observability ship as separate core features, and which detailed or debug surfaces should expose them?
rationale: Current main implements adjacent capabilities but not the exact two remaining requests; the status scan cost and desired warning visibility are product choices that source inspection cannot safely settle.

options.title: Split focused follow-ups
options.body: Track detailed CLI plugin health and debug or trace prompt-rewrite observability separately, reusing the current collectors and diagnostics contract.

options.title: Document existing surfaces
options.body: Treat chat `/status plugins`, bounded skill telemetry, and current verbose tooling as sufficient and close the remaining additions.

options.title: Keep one umbrella
options.body: Implement both remaining behaviors under this issue despite their distinct owners, output contracts, and validation paths.

recommendation.title: Split focused follow-ups
recommendation.body: Track detailed CLI plugin health and debug or trace prompt-rewrite observability separately, reusing the current collectors and diagnostics contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The original skills CLI ownership and direct issue-level product review make this the strongest available decision owner.
